job.job_description:
We are hiring a Full Stack Developer to work across frontend and backend layers of our web-based products

Responsibilities include building and maintaining features end-to-end, integrating APIs, working with databases, and participating in code reviews and sprint planning

Proficiency in React or Angular on the frontend and Node

js or Python on the backend, along with knowledge of cloud services, is required

Competitive CTC; performance bonuses; hybrid work model; opportunity to work on high-impact product features
